info.name: EDK-Enterprise-Deployment
info.description: Customer walkthrough for an EDK enterprise deployment hosted under one base domain: platform.<baseDomain> for the platform/operator plane and <tenantSlug>.<baseDomain> for tenant issuer, verifier, authorization-server, KMS and DID routes. Run folders in order; later folders consume variables captured by earlier ones.

request.description: Loads the hosted login page. The page sets the oidc_login_csrf cookie and embeds the matching tab_id and session_code hidden inputs that the credential submit must echo back.

item.name: 09 Status Lists
item.description: Creates the EuPid token status list, verifies the hosted status-list token, updates an entry, reactivates it, and reads the resulting entry state.

request.description: Creates the IETF Token Status List the EuPid configuration references, signed with the tenant's credential signing key via the overridable `statusListSigningKeyAlias` collection variable (defaults to the SD-JWT/OID4VCI assertion key `<tenantSlug>-assertion`, so the status list is signed with the same key as the credentials referencing it). The deployment configuration declares the list under the statuslists namespace; this call materializes it. The correlation id is the stable business identifier; the signed token is re-issued whenever entries change, and indexes are allocated randomly at issuance time, never sequentially. Issuance refuses to mint when a configured list cannot be resolved.
Lists status lists for the tenant after materializing the EuPid revocation list.
Reads back the created status list through the management API before checking the hosted token.
Fetches the signed status list token from the public hosting surface using the API-returned statusListUri. Verifiers dereference exactly this URL when checking credential status.
Sets the status bit at an index to 1 (revoked). A status read exposes only the bit value; whether an index is allocated is intentionally not observable.
Sets the same index back to 0 (valid).
Reads the status-list entry that was revoked and reactivated by index. This verifies the non-leaking upsert/read path for allocated and previously unallocated indexes.
